card.name: Scattered words in developing-country outbreak and village text
card.fires_on: Ordinary connecting words and punctuation inside a few passages about cholera response in low-income countries and village life in South Asia or Cambodia. It is not tied to one word.

modes.label: Cholera response text
modes.description: Words inside sentences about managing cholera cases, treatment units and capacity building.
modes.example: Cholera cases are managed in cholera treatment units (CTUs) and where there are no established CTUs, emphasis is placed on designating<< specific>> areas within the health facilities for isolation purposes

modes.label: Village daily life stories
modes.description: Commas and small words in news stories about poor rural workers, goods and shopping.
modes.example: Kamrul carries all the sacks<< of>> rice, lentil, vegetables and chicken

card.writes: It seems to push toward words about African and Asian places and goods (Ghana, Liberia, motorcycles) and away from snow and mail words.
card.plain: It fires on small words in passages about cholera control and poor village life, and has no single word trigger.
